title: The Sounding
summary: Somebody has been keeping a listening post in the Larynx Deep, and would like to be relieved of it.
author: hand-written, as the worked example for content/AUTHORING.md
notes: content: New quest — The Sounding. Sister Lull keeps a listening post in the Larynx Deep, south of the cave road. She has been there long enough to stop hearing it.
content: The post is on the map now, with a bed, a brazier and somebody in it.
content: Ward deafeners can be earned from the quest — a hood for anyone working where the Throat is loud.

items.name: Sounding rod
items.examine: Hold it to the wall and the Throat tells you where it hurts.

items.name: Ward deafeners
items.examine: Waxed felt over both ears. You will miss things. That is the idea.

npcs.name: Sister Lull
npcs.examine: Watches your mouth when you speak, and has done for years.

sign.text: LISTENING POST — keep your voice down. She is working.

quests.name: The Sounding
quests.start: Speak to Sister Lull at the listening post, south of the cave road in the Larynx Deep.
quests.desc: The Throat has been quieter on one side for eleven weeks. Sister Lull has been listening to it alone, and can no longer hear well enough to be sure.

intro: Speak up. No — face me when you do it. I read mouths now; the ears went years ago.
The east side of the Deep has gone quiet. Not quieter. Quiet. Eleven weeks of it.
The monks are packing the chambers. They think a silent Throat is a healed one.
dialogue.refuse: I am not going down there.
dialogue.briefing: Five of them, to start. Then find my sounding rod — I dropped it in the rubble and I could not hear it fall.
dialogue.nudge: Not finished. I would know; it is still quiet.
finish: That is the Throat, not you. It has been eleven weeks. Take the deafeners — you will want them now that it is loud again.
dialogue.after: Still sounding. I still cannot hear it, but I can feel it in the floor.
dialogue.locked: Come back when you have kept a vigil or two. This is not a place to learn in.

steps.text: Clear five plague monks out of the resonating chambers.
steps.tick: One fewer hand doing the packing.
steps.done: That is enough of them. Now for the rod.

steps.text: Search the rubble in the Deep for Sister Lull's sounding rod.
steps.done: The rod, under a fall of chalk. Still humming.

steps.text: Bring four ironblood ore to the post — Lull wants the chambers re-lined.
steps.done: That will line the worst of them.

quests.reportText: The chambers are clear and the rod is found. Sister Lull will want to hear about it, in her fashion.
quests.doneText: The east side of the Larynx Deep is making sound again. Sister Lull cannot hear it, and stood in it for a long time anyway.
